title: Permits & Project Planning Guide
summary: Permit requirements depend on the property, scope and trade. They should be confirmed before work that requires approval begins.
body:
## Not every repair needs the same approval
Cosmetic work, structural work, plumbing, electrical work, roofing, sidewalk work and exterior changes can have different permit or filing requirements.

## Who obtains the permit?
The written contract should identify whether a permit is required, who is responsible for obtaining it, and whether professional drawings or filings are needed.

## Building and neighborhood rules
Co-ops, condos, managed buildings and historic areas may have additional rules even when the construction scope appears straightforward.

## Build permit time into the schedule
When approvals are required, the project schedule should account for filings, reviews, inspections and any required corrections.

## Confirm the project-specific path
A site walkthrough and review of the exact scope are the right time to determine what approvals may apply.
seoTitle: NYC Home Improvement Permit Planning Guide
seoDescription: A homeowner-friendly overview of permit planning, building requirements and project approvals for renovation work.
